steps.en: Officer confirms to proceed with court application
steps.id: Officer konfirmasi lanjut ke court application
steps.why_en: No confirm screen for court application exists.
steps.why_id: Layar konfirmasi court application tidak ada.

steps.en: System assigns the next court batch number in series
steps.id: Sistem memberi nomor batch court berikutnya dalam seri
steps.why_en: No batch number generator or series exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pembuat nomor batch atau seri.

steps.en: All notices in the batch move to the next stage
steps.id: Semua notice di batch pindah ke stage berikutnya
steps.why_en: Only a separate manual stage-change tool exists; it is not linked to a court batch.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada alat ubah stage manual terpisah, tidak terkait batch court.

steps.en: Each notice carries its batch number
steps.why_en: No place to store a court batch number on notices.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat menyimpan nomor batch court di notice.

steps.en: Officer can identify the batch sent for address checks
steps.id: Officer bisa mengenali batch yang dikirim untuk cek alamat
steps.why_en: No screen or lookup for the pre-application batch exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau pencarian untuk batch sebelum pengajuan.
